detail.title: R1's GHZ4-mixture second witness pinned exactly: rho = 3/4 GHZ4 + 1/8|(A,C)> + 1/8|(A,D)>, c46 = -0.113302009 bits, classical-reducible
detail.recordedClaim: The R1 register's second ("GHZ4 mixture, +0.113302 bits") BCWW-(4.6)-violating witness is pinned exactly: rho = (3/4)|GHZ4><GHZ4| + (1/8)|s1><s1| + (1/8)|s2><s2| with {s1,s2} = the atoms (A,C) and (A,D) (masks 5,9; strings "1010","1001" under the locked convention: 4-char string = binary of the subset mask MSB-first, RIGHTMOST char = A). The state is classical-reducible: every marginal is the diagonal classical mixture {3/8 on 0000, 3/8 on 1111, 1/8 on (A,C), 1/8 on (A,D)} restricted. Exact rational prime-exponent arithmetic gives c46 = Ingleton(A:B;C,D)+I(C:D|B) = -0.113302008775 bits (exact sign -1 by integer comparison), matching the register's 6-decimal "+0.113302 bits" (the (A<->B) mirror pair masks {6,10} gives the identical value; c46 is A<->B symmetric). Identification method: exact-evaluation screen over the classical-reducible family {g*GHZ4 + b*|s> + c*|t>} (120 mask pairs x 480x480 weight grid) found the unique 6-decimal match at g=3/4, b=c=1/8, masks {5,9}; the white-noise family (1-k/12)GHZ4+(k/12)I/16 has c46 >= 0 for ALL k (pure GHZ4 sits at exact equality c46=0) and the classic Linden mixture (1/2 GHZ4 + 1/4|0101> + 1/4|1001>) evaluates POSITIVE (c46=+0.5 at masks {10,9}, +0.066..+1.19 over all 12 relabeled pairs) — neither is the R1 witness. Engine calibration anchors also locked this run: c46 on the uniform 5-atom witness = (14-9*log2(3))/5 = -0.052932501298 bits exactly, and the string convention pinned by brute force (24 relabelings x 2 readings; only rightmost=A reproduces the KB value with identity relabeling). Full entropy vectors of both witnesses: work/lock/witnesses.json; reference engine work/lock/lock_check.py (stdlib-only Fractions).
